segments.sn35.129:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
segments.sn35.129:1.2: Atha kho ghosito gahapati yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ghosito gahapati āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.129:1.4: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn35.129:1.5: “Saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, cakkhudhātu, rūpā ca manāpā, cakkhuviññāṇañca sukhavedaniyaṃ.
segments.sn35.129:1.7: Saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, cakkhudhātu, rūpā ca amanāpā, cakkhuviññāṇañca dukkhavedaniyaṃ.
segments.sn35.129:1.9: Saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, cakkhudhātu, rūpā ca manāpā upekkhāvedaniyā, cakkhuviññāṇañca adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṃ.
segments.sn35.129:1.10: Phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā … pe … saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, jivhādhātu, rasā ca manāpā, jivhāviññāṇañca sukhavedaniyaṃ.
segments.sn35.129:1.13: Saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, jivhādhātu, rasā ca amanāpā, jivhāviññāṇañca dukkhavedaniyaṃ.
segments.sn35.129:1.15: Saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, jivhādhātu, rasā ca upekkhāvedaniyā, jivhāviññāṇañca adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṃ.
segments.sn35.129:1.16: Phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā … pe … saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, manodhātu, dhammā ca manāpā, manoviññāṇañca sukhavedaniyaṃ.
segments.sn35.129:1.19: Saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, manodhātu, dhammā ca amanāpā, manoviññāṇañca dukkhavedaniyaṃ.
segments.sn35.129:1.21: Saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, manodhātu, dhammā ca upekkhāvedaniyā, manoviññāṇañca adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṃ.
segments.sn35.129:1.23: Ettāvatā kho, gahapati, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe rūpā ca manāpāti rūpā ca manāpā saṃvijjanti.
Sukhavedaniyaṃ phassanti cakkhuviññāṇasampayuttaṃ upanissayavasena javanakāle sukhavedanāya paccayabhūtaṃ phassaṃ.
Sukhā vedanāti ekaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca javanavasena sukhavedanā uppajjati.
Rūpā ca manāpāti nīlādibhedā rūpadhammā ca manasā manuññā piyarūpā saṃvijjanti, idañca sukhavedanīyassa phassassa sabhāvadassanatthaṃ.
Evaṃ “rūpā ca manāpā upekkhāvedaniyā”ti etthāpi yathārahaṃ vattabbaṃ.
Upanissayakoṭiyā hi cakkhuviññāṇasampayuttaphasso sukhavedanīyo, na sahajātakoṭiyā.
Sesapadesūti “saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, sotadhātū”ti āgatesu pañcasu koṭṭhāsesu.
